name: Omapad
author: Caner Akdas
description: The surfaces omapad draws: an on-screen keyboard, the controller menu, the bindings guide, the mapping wizard and the game-mode bar, plus a bar widget for what the pad is doing. Summon a surface with {"surface":"osk|menu|guide|map"}. Draws nothing on its own: every surface is a view onto the omapad daemon, so run install.sh from this checkout to install it.

barWidget.description: Whether a pad is connected and which mode it is in
